Name: Happy Home Designer
Author: tlitookilakin
Description:
[size=4][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Walk around and place furniture directly from the catalog, no need to close and open it.
[*]Built-in Alternative Textures support- see which items have skins, and place pre-skinned items.
[*]Use both catalogs at once, by stacking them, or combining them in your inventory.
[*]Search for both furniture and walls & floors.
[*]Easily configure the mod with GMCM.
[*]One-click placement of walls and floors for whatever room you're standing in.
[*]Blueprint book for saving and loading layouts
[*]Combined rare catalogue, for collectors
[*]End-game portable catalogue
[*]Undo/redo for one-click placement, in case of misclicks.
[*]Favorite frequently-used items to find them easily by holding down the modifier key (configurable, default ALT).
[*]Pause time while the menu is open (configurable, has no effect in multiplayer).
[*]Extended furniture categories for more fine-grained sorting (configurable).
[*]Replace the furniture & wallpaper catalogs (configurable).
[*]Built-in support for Vintage v2 and Overgrown Flowery UI recolors.
[*]And much more!
[/list][b][size=3]
Languages[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]English
[*]German
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[/list]
[size=3]For more information, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2127]The FAQ[/url].
There is also a more detailed overview of the available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2237]config options[/url].
If you are a modder looking to add support, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2126]This Page[/url].[/size]
